title: Matam Hussain Ka
body:
Matam Hussain Ka
Buniyad lailaha ki Matam Hussain ka
Tauheed ka payam hai ye gham hussain ka..
Zikre khuda Baland hai abhi Hussain se
<<DIVIDER>>
Aawaz hai aazan ki baqi Hussain se
Har zikr E haq mein zikar hai paiham Hussain ka
Sajide mein taige zulm se kat ta hai sheh ka sar
Shukare khud magar hai musal sal zaban par
<<DIVIDER>>
Kya bandagi E haq mein hai aalam Hussain ka
Takra k taqatien ye sabhi haar jainge
Koi bulandia ho usse choo na payangi
Uncha rahega qalq mein parcham Hussain ka
<<DIVIDER>>
Karbobala se door rahe ga agar Bashar
Reh reh k zulm o jaor uthate rehege sar
Duniya ko saath chahiye har dam Hussain ka
Sadiyo ke aainey ise dhundla na karsake
<<DIVIDER>>
Duniya ki aandhiyo mein b jalte rahe diye
Hoga na dil se gham ye kabhi kam Hussain ka
Zibhe azeem haq ki baqa ka hai mareka
Nabiyo ki mehnato ka khulasa hai karbala
<<DIVIDER>>
Lete hai naam aadam o khatam hussain ka
Har ek nabi ko haq ne kiya is se aashna
Karbobala K gham mein bohot roye Mustafa
Is waste ye gham hai muazzam hussain ka
<<DIVIDER>>
Mehmaam hai aaj Arsh nashi is zameen pr
Matam kada bana hai har ek matami ka ghar
Aaya hai shaher e gham mein Moharram Hussain ka
Farhan Gham mein doob k nouha zara suna
<<DIVIDER>>
Sadiq duae dati hai hum sab ko fatima
Rote hai le k naam agar hum hussain ka
